primary_sources.title: Neumann--Norbury, The Orevkov invariant of an affine plane curve
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete pages: Section4 ordinary cabling/splice and pole orders of approximate roots; Section5.2 canonical a_i recurrence and a_n=-K.Cbar-1. No global moduli theorem is imported here.

primary_sources.title: Ito, A Note on Chirally Cosmetic Surgery on Cable Knots
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete PDF5/printed167: annulus base with one exceptional order equal to winding, inner fibre pq*meridian+longitude, outer section/fibre basis M=q*c2-r*h,L=p*c2+s*h. Used only for the explicit (winding3,parameter4) cable control, where orientation signs do not affect the order2/order4 evaluations. No cosmetic-surgery theorem imported.

primary_sources.title: Pakovich--Zvonkin, Minimum degree of the difference of two polynomials over Q, PartII
primary_sources.used_statement: Complete preprint printed1-2/PDF5-6: factorization partitions and Definition1.2 of Davenport--Zannier equality pairs. Used for terminology and context. The weighted Wronskian identity, degree comparison, extremal properties and explicit six-node certificate are independently derived here; neither a classification nor an example from the paper is assumed.
